title: ranunculus auricomus proles pseudopsis
intro: Ranunculus auricomus proles pseudopsis, commonly known as Butterscotch or Golden Buttercup, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the ranunculaceae family. It is known for its bright yellow flowers and has been traditionally used for various medicinal purposes. The health benefits of Ranunculus auricomus proles pseudopsis include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including ranunculin and protoanemonin, exhibit therapeutic actions such as pain relief and immune system support.
